Home Alarm Clock & Reminders
Chrome alarm clock & reminders

Never miss what matters.

A lightweight alarm clock and reminder extension for Chrome. Set alarms in seconds, choose the sounds you like, snooze with one click and keep everything stored locally.

Add to Chrome See pricing

Everything you need

Reliable background alarms

Uses Chrome’s alarms API and an offscreen page, so alarms ring on time even when Chrome is minimized or you are in another tab.

Fullscreen ringing view

A large ringing view with big Snooze and Stop buttons — optionally in its own window.

Repeat & snooze

Repeat by weekday and choose a snooze of 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes.

Sounds & icons

Built-in sounds, labels and emoji icons for every alarm. Premium adds custom MP3 and animated icons.

Spoken alarms

Your message is read out loud when the alarm rings, in 20+ languages (Premium).

Themes & time format

Light and dark mode, accent colors and a 24h or 12h AM/PM clock.

How it works

  1. 1

    Click and add

    Click the extension icon, tap +, scroll the hours and minutes, add a label and pick an icon.

  2. 2

    Pick sound, snooze & repeat

    Choose a sound, how long snooze lasts and which weekdays the alarm repeats.

  3. 3

    Let Chrome do the rest

    When it’s time, a large ringing view shows Snooze and Stop — even if Chrome was in the background.

Frequently asked questions

Will the alarm ring if Chrome is minimized?

Yes. Alarms use Chrome’s alarms API and an offscreen page, so they ring while Chrome is running in the background or minimized.

How many alarms can I create for free?

Up to 3 alarms. Premium removes the limit.

How much is Premium?

A one-time payment from $12 for one browser — no subscription. Packs of 2, 3 and 5 licenses cost $19, $25 and $35.

Where are my alarms stored?

Locally in your browser. There is no account and no tracking.
